messages:
samir: FYI GreenWave just escalated — after today's canary their plugin-driven payments keep failing. They say the function calls arrive without Authorization and our plugin rejects them.

maria: ack. when did the canary go out? any error ids from the customer?

samir: canary started ~1769128000 per deploy-bot. customer provided a failing request + our runtime logs. snippet below. they say it worked before the canary.

samir: ```
== client request (captured by edge) ==
POST /v1/execute
Authorization: Bearer cg_xxx_greenwave
Content-Type: application/json

{"tool":"payments.charge","args":{"amount":100,"currency":"USD"}}

== internal runtime log (plugin host) ==
INFO 2026-03-16T14:12:05 request received trace=gw-2026-03-16-abc123
INFO incoming headers: {}
WARN payments plugin: missing Authorization header, dropping call
```

jordan: that looks like the edge/proxy stripped the header. any recent PR touching header passthrough?

ben: i rolled PR#3821 earlier today — it adds a header-sanitization pass for outbound tool calls (to avoid leaking upstream creds). default was supposed to preserve Authorization for internal tool calls but i see config flags. i'll check.

maria: deploy-bot, show canary timeline?

deploy-bot: canary deploy started 1769128000, step=canary-routing, completed canary traffic shift 1769128600, version=infra-proxy@2.14.0-canary

ben: ok reproducing locally — when strip-credentials=true the proxy strips Authorization from proxied requests unless allowlist contains `payments.*`. somehow the allowlist didn't get generated for this model-route during rollout. can confirm behavior change vs previous stable build.

samir: customer provided trace id gw-2026-03-16-abc123 — attaching our full trace shows proxy applied `strip-credentials: true` at route evaluation.

maria: do we have a quick mitigation? rollback the proxy canary or flip config?

ben: quick flip available — setting `preserve_internal_auth=true` in canary config. I can push a config patch and restart the canary instances, should be fast.

jordan: any risk of leaking customer creds if we flip? this is internal only config for calls between runtime->plugin host, same cluster. security approves in slack dm.

ben: pushing patch now.

deploy-bot: config update applied 1769131200 to canary group infra-proxy@2.14.0-canary (preserve_internal_auth=true)

samir: replays from GreenWave show Authorization present now and plugin calls succeed. customer confirmed via support chat: "calls are working again, thanks" :thumbsup:

maria: ok, can we roll the fix to stable? and create a test to prevent regression.

ben: i'll cut a hotfix PR to ensure allowlist is generated during route compile and add an e2e that verifies Authorization header preserved for internal tool calls. filing infra#453.

samir: closing on this thread — customer resolved. follow-up ticket infra#453 to add tests + alert on header-preservation regressions. thanks everyone.

ben: noted, adding postmortem blurb to release notes.

samir: marking resolved and informing GreenWave CSM.
